why_included: The O*NET Work Importance Locator assumes an employer (supervisors, company policies). Non-corporate lanes trade on values it cannot see: income upside vs stability, visibility, ownership, location and time freedom, scoreboards.

response_format.stem: In the work I'd most want, it is important that...

scoring.card_score: Column number (1-5). Report as a within-person ranking only; forced sorts are ipsative and must not be compared between people as levels.

items.text: the income has no ceiling, even if it is less certain.
I know roughly what I will earn every month.
many people know who I am and what I do.
I keep getting measurably better at a hard skill.
my work reaches a very large number of people.
there is a clear scoreboard and I can win.
I make things with my own hands or body.
I am part of a team working toward a shared goal.
the work can make me wealthy.
